sections_target.text: This document sets out the steps for using the hand line to rescue a person who fell and is hanging on the fall arrester, using the Canadian equipment. The first draft of this document was prepared by Mr. Tom C., the Canadian expert from Ontario Hydro.

items: Make sure there is a temporary earth on both sides of the work on the tower from which the hanging person is to be rescued.
Wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, gloves, goggles, shoes).
Wear the climbing suit and shock absorber.
Make sure the fall arrester is at a level above the work location.
Observe safety distances and approach limits from any exposed live conductor.

sections_target.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Climb the tower to a level above the fallen person and tie the safety belt to a suitable tower angle.
Place the hand line pulley above the level of the fallen person and separate the hand line into two parts.
Wrap the hand line, from the self-locking ring side, around a suitable tower angle above the level of the fallen person.
Place the hand line hook in the (D) ring on the back of the fallen person.
At least two persons lift the weight of the fallen person using the hand line.
The linesman on the tower removes the fall arrester cable from the (D) ring and puts the self-locking ring of the hand line in its place.
Take up all the slack in the hand line (the rescue rope) and release the hand line hook.
Lower the injured person by releasing and pushing the rope to control the descent of the fallen person to the ground.
Give first aid to the injured person, and artificial respiration if required.

sections_target.text: If a person falls out of reach of the linesman on the tower, place the hand line where you can bring the fallen person closer to the tower so that the linesman on the tower can reach him.
In some cases this method is impractical, so the rope ladder is used to reach the fallen person. Site name: Equipment code: Carried out by: Signature: Date of execution:

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for using the hand line to rescue a person who fell and is hanging on the fall arrester, using the Canadian equipment. The first draft of this document was prepared by Mr. Tom C., the Canadian expert from Ontario Hydro.
Safety Precautions
Make sure there is a temporary earth on both sides of the work on the tower from which the hanging person is to be rescued.
Wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, gloves, goggles, shoes).
Wear the climbing suit and shock absorber.
Make sure the fall arrester is at a level above the work location.
Observe safety distances and approach limits from any exposed live conductor.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Hand line set
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Climb the tower to a level above the fallen person and tie the safety belt to a suitable tower angle. | 1
Place the hand line pulley above the level of the fallen person and separate the hand line into two parts. | 2
Wrap the hand line, from the self-locking ring side, around a suitable tower angle above the level of the fallen person. | 3
Place the hand line hook in the (D) ring on the back of the fallen person. | 4
At least two persons lift the weight of the fallen person using the hand line. | 5
The linesman on the tower removes the fall arrester cable from the (D) ring and puts the self-locking ring of the hand line in its place. | 6
Take up all the slack in the hand line (the rescue rope) and release the hand line hook. | 7
Lower the injured person by releasing and pushing the rope to control the descent of the fallen person to the ground. | 8
Give first aid to the injured person, and artificial respiration if required. | 9
Notes
If a person falls out of reach of the linesman on the tower, place the hand line where you can bring the fallen person closer to the tower so that the linesman on the tower can reach him.
In some cases this method is impractical, so the rope ladder is used to reach the fallen person. Site name: Equipment code: Carried out by: Signature: Date of execution:
